$comment: THE SYNERGY SYSTEM — NBA 2K27's replacement for badge boosts.
SOURCED from 2K's official MyPLAYER Builder page (https://nba.2k.com/2k27/features/myplayer-builder/):
- 16 total Synergy slots: TWELVE give +1, FOUR give +2.
- Synergy is what lets a badge reach LEGEND tier. Legend cannot be obtained at build creation.
- Synergy has two halves. A FUSE badge gets a permanent +1/+2 for the whole game. A REACTION
badge is paired to a Fuse badge and gets the same boost once the Fuse badge has triggered a
set number of times in that game.
- Putting a badge in a Fuse slot REFUNDS the badge tokens you would have spent equipping it.
That is a real optimizer interaction: a Fused badge is free, so Synergy effectively buys both
a tier and slot budget back.
- Synergy is earned from Season rewards, Build Specialization, Crew progression and REP. Season
Synergy expires at season end; the rest is permanent and account-wide.
- Slots are interchangeable across disciplines, EXCEPT Build Specialization slots, which are
NOT SOURCED: how many of the 16 slots a given player actually has unlocked (it depends entirely on
their REP/Season/Crew progress), and the Fuse->Reaction trigger counts. `availableSlots` below is
what the optimizer plans against and should be set to what you actually own.

verification.notes: Slot counts and mechanics are official. How many slots a specific player owns is not.

availableSlots.$comment: How many slots THIS player has unlocked. Synergy is earned, so a new account has none. Set to totalSlots to plan the end-state build. The UI exposes these.

verification.notes: Depends on your REP/Season/Crew progress; not a game constant.
fuseRefundsTokens and legendOnlyViaSynergy are stated outright. canStackOnSameBadge is an assumption — 2K does not say whether a badge can take both a +1 and a +2.

reaction.$comment: Reaction badges mirror their Fuse partner's boost after the Fuse badge triggers enough times in-game. Not modelled in the optimizer: it is an in-game runtime condition, not a build-creation decision. Recorded so it is not mistaken for something the app forgot.
